name: DLF Ltd
description: DLF Ltd is India's largest publicly listed real estate company, with over 75 years of real estate development track record. The company transformed Gurgaon into a premier global business and residential hub, operating a two-pronged model: high-margin luxury residential development (DLF Ltd) and institutional commercial office leasing via DLF Cyber City Developers Ltd (DCCDL) in joint venture with GIC Singapore.

company_profile.summary: DLF Ltd is India's largest publicly listed real estate company, with over 75 years of real estate development track record. The company transformed Gurgaon into a premier global business and residential hub, operating a two-pronged model: high-margin luxury residential development (DLF Ltd) and institutional commercial office leasing via DLF Cyber City Developers Ltd (DCCDL) in joint venture with GIC Singapore.

revenue_breakup.desc: Super-luxury condominiums (The Camellias, Privana), premium apartments, and plotted developments.
Grade-A office towers leased to Fortune 500 enterprises in Gurugram, Chennai, and Hyderabad.
Destination shopping centers (DLF Mall of India, CyberHub) and business club properties.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% focused on Delhi-NCR, Gurugram, Chennai, and Goa
moats_and_strengths: Pristine luxury brand equity in Delhi-NCR, capable of selling out multi-thousand-crore luxury projects within days of launch.
Massive fully paid-up land bank of 215+ million sq. ft. acquired at low historical costs.
DCCDL commercial office portfolio (42M+ sq. ft.) delivers predictable, inflation-linked rental annuity cash flows.
Achieved net debt-zero balance sheet status, transforming corporate financial stability.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Operational Rental Portfolio: 42+ Million sq. ft. • Development Pipeline: 35+ Million sq. ft. launch pipeline

bullish_triggers: Unprecedented pre-sales velocity for ultra-luxury residential launches in Gurugram (Privana West, Dahlias).
Planned REIT listing of commercial office subsidiary DCCDL unlocking massive capital value.
Expansion of retail mall footprint into Goa and Gurugram.
bearish_risks: Geographic concentration of development revenue in the Delhi-NCR property market.
Delays in municipal infrastructural approvals and environmental clearances for mega-townships.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)

faqs.question: What is the MTF margin required to trade DLF Ltd (DLF) on NSE?
faqs.answer: DLF Ltd (DLF) is approved under SEBI's Margin Trading Facility (MTF) with an initial maintenance margin requirement of approximately 20%. This enables swing traders to access 5.0x purchasing power on eligible Indian brokerage platforms.
